# Nikodem Boryczka — Full Portfolio Context

## Profile
Nikodem Boryczka is an AI Developer and Software Engineer from Silesia, Poland. Currently a student at Programming Technical School with AI specialization. Open-source enthusiast building enterprise-grade tools and web applications.

## Technical Expertise

### Languages
Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, HTML, CSS

### Backend
Flask, FastAPI, REST API design, JWT authentication, rate limiting, layered architecture (API → Service → Repository), SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic migrations, async patterns

### Frontend
React 19, React Hooks, motion (Framer Motion), Tailwind CSS v4, progressive web apps, offline-first architecture, glassmorphism design

### DevOps & Infrastructure
Docker, Docker Compose, Gunicorn, Render deployment, Linux administration, Git version control

### Databases
PostgreSQL (ThreadedConnectionPool), Redis (caching, fallback patterns), SQLite (testing)

### Testing
pytest, testcontainers, async tests with aiosqlite, CI/CD pipelines

## Architecture Philosophy
- Layered architectures with clear separation of concerns
- Soft-delete patterns for data integrity
- CSRF protection, rate limiting, audit logging
- Graceful degradation with fallback mechanisms
- Local-first data persistence
- Service worker versioned cache strategies

## Portfolio Site Details
This portfolio is built as an interactive Ubuntu desktop simulator using React 19. Features include:
- Canvas-based animated aurora background with performance detection
- GNOME-style Activities Overview overlay
- Functional terminal emulator with 20+ commands
- Window management system (drag, resize, minimize, maximize)
- Right-click desktop context menu
- Notification system with toast animations
- Mobile-responsive full-screen window adaptation
- No external image dependencies — all visuals are CSS/canvas/SVG

## Projects

### OSP Logbook
Full-stack web application for fire brigade logistics management.
- Flask + PostgreSQL with ThreadedConnectionPool
- Redis cache with OrderedDict fallback
- Docker + Gunicorn + Render deployment
- 40+ pytest tests with testcontainers
- PWA with service worker offline support
- Soft-delete, CSRF, rate limiting, audit log
- GitHub: https://github.com/t91a60/osp-logbook

### AlkoRater
Premium iOS PWA for alcohol cataloging and rating.
- iOS-native glassmorphism design language
- Hardware-accelerated UI with haptic feedback
- Service worker with versioned cache strategy
- Local-first architecture with JSON persistence
- Flexible schema normalization
- Category-specific accent colors
- GitHub: https://github.com/t91a60/alko-rater

### Gather
Event/social REST API with modern layered architecture.
- FastAPI with auto-generated OpenAPI/Swagger
- Layered architecture: API → Service → Repository
- Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Alembic migrations
- Redis caching with graceful fallback
- JWT access + refresh token authentication
- Rate limiting middleware (sliding window)
- Docker + docker-compose deployment
- Async pytest on aiosqlite in-memory
- GitHub: https://github.com/t91a60/Gather

### UPM Ultras
Official fan club website for Ultras Polonia Międzyrzecze.
- Responsive static site
- CSS grid layout + mobile adaptation
- Photo gallery with lightbox
- Clear information hierarchy
- GitHub: https://github.com/t91a60/upm-ultras
